content.stem: 在确定制裁筛查的模糊匹配阈值时,应考虑以下因素:

options.A: 处理潜在匹配项所带来的操作负担.
options.B: 对违规行为处以罚款的金额.
options.C: 团队处理潜在匹配的经验
options.D: 要筛选的数据是否可靠且经过验证

content.stem_en: When deciding on the fuzzy matching threshold for sanctions screening, consideration should be given to:

options_en.A: The operational burden of dealing with potential matches.
options_en.B: The value of fines for non-compliance.
options_en.C: The experience of the team dealing with potential matches.
options_en.D: Whether the data to be screened is reliable and verified.
